Total return = (7,500 / 10,000) − 1 = −25%.
CAGR = (7,500 / 10,000)^(1/2) − 1 ≈ −13.4% per year.

通信示例：118/177 × 100 = 66.67%；上期116/177 = 65.54%；按原始计数计算差值+1.13个百分点。覆盖177/177；与总体历史7/8无关。
来源标识
f02.fixture.v3/macro/sector/communication_services/share_above_50d/2026-10-30
观测
2026年10月30日 · 已结算20:00 UTC
发布
2026年10月30日 · 20:02 UTC
获取
2026年10月30日 · 20:03 UTC
单位与范围
比例：百分比；变化：百分点（pp）。当前行表示通信服务行业，不是市场总体。
覆盖范围说明
本行覆盖177/177；总体八期历史覆盖7/8，群体独立。示例不代表实时响应。
返回“通信服务”行
构建说明 · 不是已执行的交互测试
单一命名模态：初始焦点在“关闭”，Tab / Shift+Tab留在对话框内，背景不可操作。仅当前拥有焦点的层处理Esc；关闭时若模态拥有焦点，返回同一来源按钮；若该行已移除，返回“行业对比”标题并说明原因。保留排序、筛选、横向滚动，以及用户之后主动移走的焦点。
打开、关闭或切换语言均不保存，也不创建新的URL。保留现有路由、实体键和历史行为。

arguments.html:
Compare the averages
The arithmetic average is 0%. The total return is −25% over two years. The compound annual return is about −13.4% per year. These measures answer different questions, so the period and unit stay beside the number.
Total return
(7,500 / 10,000) − 1 = −25%.
CAGR
(7,500 / 10,000)^(1/2) − 1 ≈ −13.4% per year.
Where this example stops
Reordering the same returns does not change the final balance when no cash enters or leaves. Contributions and withdrawals change that relationship. A fixed-rate calculator describes assumptions; it does not predict future returns.
Explore the assumptions
Use the existing tools to examine an annualized return or a contribution schedule. Keep the period, currency and cash-flow assumptions in view.
CAGR calculator ↗Compounding calculator ↗Back to the desk ↗

BUILD CONTRACT · OUTSIDE THE PRODUCT
These are portable presentation fixtures, not new domain data, schemas, billing decisions or endpoints. The source-bound retained table rows and Macro summary keep their original values and identities. Counterfactual definition/currency inputs are explicitly separate from the normal Company fixture.
Bind filter clearing, coverage inspection, retry reads, evidence return and saved-object opening to the existing host owner. Error does not erase valid retained rows; source unavailability is not access denial; unknown counts and periods do not become zero. A confirmed save changes the write axis only.
Native application/readback, exact geometry, screenshots, keyboard/ARIA, focus/scroll return, real source integration and actual write readback remain unverified. VirtualizedDataInspector, CountLadder, LifecycleRail and DecisionRow / VerdictHero remain retained and unqualified.

arguments.html:
Candidate boundary and retained responsibilities
F02 owns shared anatomy and tokens. F01 owns the joint shell/navigation contract. Domain owners retain their source identities, routes, access rules, verdicts, count partitions, lifecycle transitions and saved-state authority.
The repaired native subset is applied and captured. The Chinese comparison board 7IS-0 remains incomplete under its original unresolved chart-footer operation; its separate evidence-return companion does not replace it. Release remains held for terminal reconciliation, full-set review, F01 joint qualification, actual browser keyboard/touch/400% proof, complete consumer/domain integration and formal admitted review.
F02 retains the accepted candidate.2 geometry and records clause-specific concurrence with F01 candidate.4. Brain Close is distinct from Stop; conditional focus ownership, the focused Terminal reader exception and the existing shared-component owners remain explicit source contracts, not executed runtime proof.
All numerical examples are illustrative. Participation uses the count-first v3 fixture; Company and Options keep their existing v2 raw records. The earlier HTML/static candidate is historical supporting evidence. No product implementation, merge or deployment is claimed.
